task.task_name: Review and approve a supplier invoice
task.task_description: Check a supplier invoice for authenticity, accuracy, and agreement with what the company ordered and received; resolve discrepancies; and approve it under company policy.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Verify supplier identity and invoice authenticity
operational_subtasks.description: Compare supplier details and invoice characteristics with the approved supplier record and available invoice information to identify signs that the invoice may not be genuine.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one routine check per invoice, including a brief comparison with the supplier record; no separate fraud investigation is assumed unless a discrepancy is found.

operational_subtasks.description: Search available accounts-payable records for a prior invoice with matching supplier, invoice number, or other identifying details.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one search per invoice using the available AP system and identifying details; this does not repeat the supplier-authenticity review.

operational_subtasks.description: Compare invoiced items, quantities ordered, prices, and payment terms with the purchase order and identify discrepancies.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one comparison per invoice against an available purchase order, with a routine number of line items. Missing or inconsistent order information is handled as conditional exception work.

operational_subtasks.description: Compare the invoice quantities with warehouse receipt records for the supplied materials and identify differences.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one review of available receipt records per invoice. The purchase-order comparison findings remain available, so this estimate covers only the additional receipt-record check.

operational_subtasks.description: Check line extensions, taxes, totals, and listed charges against the invoice details and available order information.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one calculation review per invoice with a routine number of lines. Price-to-order comparison is covered separately; this estimate covers arithmetic and review of taxes and charges.

operational_subtasks.description: For identified discrepancies, obtain and assess relevant information from purchasing, the warehouse, or the supplier, and determine whether the issue is resolved or the invoice information needs correction.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Planning assumption: an exception-resolution episode is needed for about 0.25 invoices on average. Allow 18 minutes of active work per episode for investigation and coordination; passive response or waiting time is excluded.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Determine approval eligibility and record approval
operational_subtasks.description: Use the completed checks and any resolved discrepancies to determine whether the invoice meets company approval policy, then record the approval in the AP system.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one final policy and approval-authority check per invoice, using the findings already gathered, followed by the brief system action to record approval.

parent_output_contract.completion_boundary: The invoice has been checked for authenticity, duplication, agreement with the purchase order and receipt records, and calculation accuracy; identified issues have been resolved; and an eligible invoice has been approved in the AP system under company policy.

activities.activity_name: Review agent findings before invoice authorization
activities.description: Review the agents’ identity, duplication, order, receipt, calculation, and approval-eligibility findings for material errors or unresolved uncertainty before relying on them. activities.trigger: Before the human approver relies on the agent outputs to make the required invoice approval decision.
activities.expected_action: Assess the reported findings and eligibility assessment; seek correction or clarification if they appear materially incomplete or inaccurate, and use the reviewed results in the approval decision.

activity_effort_estimates.rationale: Review the consolidated agent findings and eligibility assessment once per invoice, checking for material errors or unresolved uncertainty before relying on them. assumptions: Agent findings are presented together in a concise, usable format.
